children: COTI's Privacy-on-Demand infrastructure is live on Avalanche mainnet, bringing general-purpose private computation to C-Chain applications and Avalanche L1s. The launch also introduces the Privacy Portal, which offers one-click private AVAX and USDC, extending COTI's privacy tooling to Avalanche's institutional and developer ecosystem.

For COTI, the deployment moves its privacy layer from a single-chain product to infrastructure available across a large smart contract ecosystem. Private AVAX and USDC through the Privacy Portal lower the setup barrier for applications handling sensitive balances or transaction data. Adoption remains the open question: the addressable market is materially larger, but actual usage by C-Chain developers and institutions is still to be demonstrated.

title: Avalanche: COTI Privacy-on-Demand Goes Live on Mainnet - 16 Sep 2026
